arxiv-2207-07020.title: Estimating sparse direct effects in multivariate regression with the spike-and-slab LASSO
arxiv-2207-07020.creator: Yunyi Shen, Claudia Solís-Lemus, Sameer K. Deshpande
arxiv-2207-07020.description: Abstract The multivariate regression interpretation of the Gaussian chain graph model simultaneously parametrizes (i) the direct effects of p p predictors on q q outcomes and (ii) the residual partial covariances between pairs of outcomes. We introduce a new method for fitting sparse versions of these models with spike-and-slab LASSO (SSL) priors.

arxiv-2208-06204.description: Abstract Context. Stellar occultation is a powerful technique that allows the determination of some physical parameters of the occulting object. The result depends on the photometric accuracy, the temporal resolution, and the number of chords obtained. Space telescopes can achieve high photometric accuracy as they are not affected by atmospheric scintillation. Aims.

arxiv-2310-16791.title: Covert Planning against Imperfect Observers Conference: Under review for the 23rd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2024); May 6 – 10, 2024; Auckland, New Zealand 851
arxiv-2310-16791.creator: Haoxiang Ma, Chongyang Shi, Shuo Han, Michael R. Dorothy, Jie Fu
arxiv-2310-16791.description: Abstract . Covert planning refers to a class of constrained planning problems where an agent aims to accomplish a task with minimal information leaked to a passive observer to avoid detection. However, existing methods of covert planning often consider deterministic environments or do not exploit the observer’s imperfect information.

arxiv-2503-12018.title: CompArt: Operationalizing Aesthetic Alignment in Text-to-Image Generation via Principles of Art
arxiv-2503-12018.creator: Zhe JIN, Tat-Seng CHUA
arxiv-2503-12018.description: Abstract . Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have made rapid progress on semantic alignment (generating what is described in the prompt), yet users still lack reliable control over aesthetic composition (how visual elements are put together). Prior work often treats aesthetics as a single, preference-driven notion (e.g., “high quality”, “detailed”, “breathtaking”), which does not map cleanly to compositional intent.

arxiv-2505-13060.title: Automatic mixed precision for optimizing gained time with constrained loss mean-squared-error based on model partition to sequential sub-graphs
arxiv-2505-13060.creator: Shmulik Markovich-Golan, Daniel Ohayon, Itay Niv, Yair Hanani
arxiv-2505-13060.description: Abstract Quantization is essential for NN ( NN ) compression, reducing model size and computational demands by using lower bit-width data types, though aggressive reduction often hampers accuracy. MP ( MP ) mitigates this tradeoff by varying the numerical precision across network layers. This study focuses on automatically selecting an optimal MP configuration within PTQ ( PTQ ) for inference.

arxiv-2601-19281.description: Abstract . Smart glasses enhance interactions with the environment by using head-mounted cameras to observe the user’s viewpoint , but lack the visual feedback used for common interactions. We introduce “Gazeify then Voiceify”, a multimodal approach allowing object selection via gaze and voice using displayless smart glasses.

pmc-13387618.title: Uncertainty-aware quantitative analysis of high-throughput live cell migration data
pmc-13387618.creator: Simo Kitanovski, Shannon Conroy, Justin Sonneck, Lukas Claas, Madeleine Dorsch, Sebastian Urban, Jianxu Chen, Markus Kaiser, Barbara M. Grüner, Daniel Hoffmann, Dimitrios Vavylonis, Dimitrios Vavylonis, Dimitrios Vavylonis
pmc-13387618.description: Cell migration is a fundamental biological process essential for embryonal development, immune function, and cancer metastasis, with migration velocity representing a key parameter of this behaviour. pmc-13684533.title: HiC-LEGO: Biologically Guided High-Resolution 3D Genome Reconstruction Preserves Chromatin Organization at Kilobase Resolution
pmc-13684533.creator: Abhishek Pandeya, Md Fahimul Kabir Chowdhury, Oluwatosin Oluwadare
pmc-13684533.description: Three-dimensional (3D) chromosome reconstruction from Hi-C contact maps remains challenging because genome organization is hierarchical and fine-resolution models must reconcile local structure with chromosome-scale constraints. Here we present HiC-LEGO, a domain-aware hierarchical framework integrating ensemble chromatin domains with graph-based structural learning and progressive chromosome assembly.
